It brings together sacred text libraries (Bhagavad Gita, Stotras, Mantras, Chalisas, Aartis), advanced Vedic astrology tools (Kundli, Panchang, Numerology, Muhurat), and a massive product marketplace spanning bracelets, gemstones, Rudraksha, yantras, puja items, and jewellery from multiple brands. Features include personalized numerology reports, Stripe checkout with EMI support, puja booking with priest assignment, and an AI-powered Krishna chat.
